summary:
I will enable **Custom 3D Models** for mobs by allowing you to import **Blockbench Java Models**.

Key additions:
- **Custom Model Support**: In the "Add Entity" tab, you'll be able to upload a `.java` model file exported directly from **Blockbench** (using their "Java Entity Model" export).
- **Automated Integration**: I will automatically adjust the package and class names of your uploaded model so it works perfectly with the rest of your mod's code.
- **AI-Only Focus**: The mod maker will now focus on the "Logic" (AI behaviors) and let you handle the "Visuals" (3D shapes) in Blockbench.
- **Expanded AI Selection**: I'll include the previously mentioned behaviors (Melee, Leap, Tameable, etc.) to give your custom 3D mobs unique personalities.
